content.text: Section 18 is fully populated; all preferred limits and the certificate mechanic are present.

input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 meets the preferred insurance position in full: CGL at USD 1,000,000 per occurrence / USD 2,000,000 aggregate, professional E&O at USD 2,000,000, cyber and privacy liability at USD 5,000,000 (unconditional, so it covers Vendor's processing of our health data), and workers' compensation as required by law, all maintained through the term plus one year. Section 18.2 supplies certificates of insurance on request, plus insurer quality, primacy, cancellation notice and non-limitation of Vendor's liability, which are additional protections in our favour. No redline is warranted.
